title: VTC: fix ring-call decline mechanism (don't abuse lobbyState)
description: Line 463 says declining a ring call patches lobbyState to rejected, but lobbyState is defined only for lobby-enabled calls. The parenthetical '(or a dedicated decline signal)' admits this is unfinished. Add a dedicated responseState field on VTCParticipant for ring calls with values: pending, accepted, declined. Or use a dedicated VTCCall/set decline operation.
close_reason: Added callResponse field (pending/accepted/declined) to VTCParticipant for ring-call decline. No longer abuses lobbyState.
